About the café

A neighborhood café, built brick by brick.

Tucked into Old Town in Columbus, The Brick and Mortar Cafe is the kind of place that knows your order, saves you the good table, and always has something fresh coming out of the oven.

Our story

Where coffee meets community.

That’s not just a line on our door — it’s how this café came to be. The Brick and Mortar started with a simple idea: Old Town deserved a place where neighbors could slow down, run into each other, and feel genuinely looked after. So that’s what got built, one brick, one table, one regular at a time.

Everything here is made with care. The coffee is thoughtfully sourced, the treats are baked in-house, and the menu keeps a balance of cozy staples and seasonal surprises — a lavender vanilla latte one week, something new in the pastry case the next.

Whether you’re grabbing a cup on your way through the morning, settling in with a book, or meeting a friend you haven’t seen in too long, there’s a seat here with your name on it.

Meet Heather — owner & heart of the café

Heather is the owner of The Brick and Mortar Cafe, and the warmth people talk about starts with her. She built this place to feel like an extension of a good neighbor’s kitchen — welcoming, unhurried, and always glad you came by. If you stop in, there’s a good chance she’s the one greeting you at the counter.

Good to know before you come

General guidance to help you plan — call us at (762) 524-7360 and we’ll confirm the details for your visit.

Parking

You’ll find parking close by in the Old Town area. Mornings and lunch can fill up fast, so arriving a few minutes early never hurts.

Sit out front

On a pretty day, take one of the tables along the covered walkway out front — it’s the best seat in the neighborhood for people-watching.

Groups & big orders

Bringing a group or ordering pastries for the office? Call ahead and the team can have everything ready when you arrive.

Get in touch

Questions? Just ask.

Wondering what’s in the case today, planning a get-together, or just want to say hi? The fastest way to reach us is always a phone call.
